diffSummary: Invalid commands and environments are rejected instead of falling back to staging.
State JSON corruption is fatal; state writes are atomic and non-sensitive checkpoints are persisted after each resource phase.
Database migrations run through a repository-owned checksum/lock runner using DIRECT_DATABASE_URL from the environment.
Supabase runtime and migration URLs are separated (transaction pooler vs direct host).
The invalid R2 token-factory branch was removed; bucket-scoped S3 credentials are required explicitly.
Production release requires explicit production approval plus backup confirmation.
Custom web origins are propagated into API CORS.
Railway resource IDs/domains are checkpointed as they are created.

verification.syntax: all ops and migration scripts passed node --check
verification.credentiallessPreflight: expected failure; variable names only; Node >=22 requirement enforced

rationale: Make bootstrap/release fail closed, resumable and non-secret before connecting any cloud account.
